monthlyPrice.label: Price per month

freeCancellationDays.label: Free cancellation (days before arrival)

amenities.description: What a stay offers — a pool, free Wi-Fi, a hairdryer — at the property, in the room, or both. The stay form's Facilities and a room's Amenities read this one list.

name.label: Name
name.hint: For example: Rooftop pool. Renaming keeps the link name, so saved stays keep their tick.

groupName.label: Group
groupName.hint: The heading it is picked under.

level.label: Offered
level.hint: At the property: every guest can use it, whatever room they book. In the room: it differs room by room. Both: the hotel has it, and a room can say so too.

sortOrder.hint: Click between two, or use the arrows. The others move to make room.

iconKey.label: Icon
iconKey.hint: The small picture beside its name on the apps. None draws a tick.

badge-definitions.label: Badge
badge-definitions.description: What a traveller earns for exploring: browsing, reviewing and collecting stamps. The track and tier follow from how a badge is earned; a new badge gets a period for every season.

iconKey.label: Icon
iconKey.hint: An icon name, e.g. `compass` — not an upload.

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.hint: How many it takes within one badge period.

destinationIds.label: Destinations
destinationIds.hint: Only for stamps at chosen destinations.

badge-periods.label: Badge period
badge-periods.description: The windows badges are earned in, one per badge per season. Progress starts again when a new period begins. Saving a season rewrites its periods, so change the season rather than one of these.

seasons.label: Season
seasons.description: The tourist calendar: when the high and green seasons run. Saving a season updates every badge's period for it to the same name and dates; deleting one retires those periods. Two seasons on the calendar may not overlap.

ACTIVE.label: Active
ACTIVE.hint: on the calendar — every badge's period for it is live

INACTIVE.label: Retired
INACTIVE.hint: off the calendar — its badge periods are retired too

startsOn.label: Starts on
startsOn.hint: Inclusive. No two seasons may start on the same day.

endsOn.label: Ends on
endsOn.hint: Inclusive — a season owns its closing day.
